_comment: Presentation schema for GameplayTweaks.ini. GameplayTweaks.ini remains the
single source of truth for which settings exist, their values and their
documentation; this file only says how the editor arranges and labels them.
Nothing here may name a key that does not exist in the INI or in the code
that reads it. Every 'dev' flag and every 'choices' list carries a citation
in the entry itself or in the notes below.
Layout model (GitHub #17): the page is two columns of CATEGORIES; each
category lays its SUBCATEGORIES out as columns inside it.
['Section','*'] means 'every remaining key of that INI section, in INI
order'. Sections absent from this file still render as their own category,
so a newly added INI section is never lost.
'dev' settings are the ones the runtime itself gates behind
developmentModeActive() (GameplayTweaks/script.cpp:88), or that the INI
documents as a probe/trace/diagnostic. They are shown with a distinct
background here and are the set the in-game menu should hide when developer
mode is off.
'const' entries are the settings the running game cannot observe after a
save. Each entry carries the exact action boundary shown by LEXEDITOR.
Keys absent from 'const' were audited against loadConfig(), the INI mtime
watcher, or their module-owned bounded re-read path and remain live.
_booleans_note: Authoritative UI types. The #18 verifier extracts literal readB(section,key,...) calls, direct GetPrivateProfileIntA(section,key,...) != 0 calls, and the camera boolean-reader family from GameplayTweaks source. It also requires every INI field whose current literal is 0 or 1 to be classified here, in choices/ranges, or in numeric_0_1_exceptions. An unclassified new 0/1 field fails generation and verification instead of silently becoming a numeric input.
_numeric_0_1_exceptions_note: These settings currently contain the literal 0 or 1 but are numeric or enumerated values, not booleans. Keeping this list explicit prevents the generator from guessing a type from the current value.
_dev_note: Runtime-gated by developmentModeActive(): HorseNeeds|DevelopmentTrace (modules/horse_needs.cpp:89), CollectibleProbe|Enabled (script.cpp:1188), Prone|DevelopmentTrace (script.cpp:1216), BottleProbe|Enabled (script.cpp:1284), Climbing|DevelopmentTrace (script.cpp:1361), SpentCasings|DebugMarker (script.cpp:1447), CombatRoll|DevelopmentTrace (script.cpp:1453), Campsites|Key and Campsites|RespawnWindowMs (the placement keypress sits inside #if GAMEPLAYTWEAKS_DEV_MODE and is ANDed with developmentModeActive() at modules/world_economy.cpp:1194-1196), CollectibleMap|DeveloperMoveMaxDistance (its only consumer is the dev-gated F2 relocate at script.cpp:2620-2626). Declared diagnostics or authoring controls: CoreClock|WriteMode, Binoculars|ShowZoomReadout, CompendiumGlintProbe, AlwaysHolster|Log, SpentCasings|DebugMarker, RadialAmmoCounts|HeartbeatMs, the WantedSystem trace controls, and ReconTagging|PlantMarkerLiftCm plus ReconTagging|TagHeadGapMeters. The stamina mode readout is not a setting; it follows the shared runtime development latch directly.

_const_note: Audited against the actual readers: script.cpp loadConfig is called by the GameplayTweaks.ini file-mtime watcher; module-owned bounded re-read paths cover Minimap, HumanMovement, HorseNeeds, horse core clocks, CanteenDeveloper, PremiumCigaretteCards, ReconTagging presentation, RadialAmmoCounts and ProjectileVisibility; per-use reads cover HorsePersistence and CasingEjection. The entries above are the exceptions: startup-only readers, first-use caching, a data-build input, or keys with no current runtime reader.

BeltLantern|AttachmentPoint.cite: All values resolve in _downloads/rdr3_discoveries/boneNames/player_zero__boneNames.lua. PH_Belt_Thrower is the only proved vanilla lantern anchor and remains the runtime fallback.

ReconTagging|TagDisplayMode.cite: GameplayTweaks/modules/recon.cpp reads 3D explicitly and uses 2D for every other value. Both modes render non-occluded HUD art; 3D uses the user-set bounded distance curve.

ProjectileVisibility|Mode.cite: GameplayTweaks/script.cpp:1198-1202 parses this string: "corona" selects mode 2, "off" or "disabled" select mode 0, anything else falls through to the luminous streak (mode 4). The three names offered here are the ones GameplayTweaks.ini:705-707 documents.

Pocketwatch|FontFace.cite: GameplayTweaks/modules/pocketwatch_time.cpp validates these five built-in RDR2 font faces and falls back to body1. GameplayTweaks/ini-fragments/github-147.ini defines body1 as the default.

help.Minimap|Enabled: 0 restores vanilla dynamic minimap zoom; 1 pins the minimap to the preset nearest ZoomLevel.
help.Minimap|ZoomLevel: Scale, not a level. Values below 2 hide minimap icons and are blocked. The nearest safe preset is used from 2.2, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 5.0, 7.0 and 10.0 (widest). Higher settings show more ground, so map icons that end up too close together stop being drawn — the same thinning you see when you zoom the pause map out. Changes hot-reload within about two seconds.
help.HumanStamina|StandingRate: Net outer-stamina points per real second while standing still. Positive recovers.
help.HumanStamina|WalkingSneakingRate: Net outer-stamina points per real second while walking or sneaking.
help.HumanStamina|SprintingRate: Net outer-stamina points per real second while sprinting. Negative drains.
help.HumanStamina|SwimmingRate: Net outer-stamina points per real second while swimming. Negative drains.
help.HorseStamina|StandingRate: Net outer-stamina points per real second while the horse stands still.
help.HorseStamina|WalkingRate: Net outer-stamina points per real second at a walk.
help.HorseStamina|TrottingRate: Net outer-stamina points per real second at a trot.
help.HorseStamina|CanteringRate: Net outer-stamina points per real second at a canter. Negative drains.
help.HorseStamina|GallopingRate: Net outer-stamina points per real second at a gallop. Negative drains.
help.HorseStamina|SwimmingRate: Net outer-stamina points per real second while the horse swims.
help.HorseStamina|RoadSpeedMultiplier: Multiplies the current ridden horse's movement rate only while it is stably on a road. It applies independently of the Horse Stamina master switch. 1.0 preserves the configured baseline; valid values are 0.10-1.15. Saved changes are re-read within about two real seconds; no restart is required.
help.HorseNeeds|IdleSeconds: How long the owned horse must be left idle before it may walk to a trough or grazing scenario.
help.HorseNeeds|TriggerBelowCorePercent: The mapped core must be below this percentage before the horse bothers to go and use a scenario.
help.HorseNeeds|MinimumPlayerDistance: The horse will not start using a scenario closer to you than this.
help.HorseNeeds|MaximumPlayerDistance: Scenarios farther than this from you are ignored.
help.HorseNeeds|ApproachTimeoutSeconds: Give up the walk to a scenario after this long.
help.HorseNeeds|MinimumUseSeconds: Shortest time spent at the scenario once it is reached.
help.HorseNeeds|MaximumUseSeconds: Longest time spent at the scenario before the horse moves on.
help.HorseNeeds|RestoreIntervalMs: How often, while using a scenario, the mapped core is topped up.
help.HorseNeeds|RestorePointsPerTick: Core points restored on each of those ticks.
help.HorseNeeds|CooldownSeconds: Minimum time between one scenario use and the next.
help.HorsePersistence|Enabled: Keeps the owned saddle horse at its last recorded world position across a full game restart instead of accepting vanilla's startup relocation.
help.Campsites|Key: Windows virtual-key code, read raw from the keyboard. 0x72 = F3 (default), 0x73 = F4, 0x74 = F5. Tap to place a campsite; hold about 0.8s while standing at one to remove it.
help.Campsites|RespawnWindowMs: How long after death the campsite position keeps being re-asserted. The game clears its dead flag before it finishes placing you, so a single teleport loses the race; this holds the position through the fade-in.
help.AnimalDensity|Multiplier: Global wild-animal spawn density. 1.0 is vanilla and 2.0 is twice as many ambient animals; leave it at the vanilla value to disable the feature.
help.CoreXPGain|Enabled: Allows ordinary Rockstar activity XP to raise Health / Stamina / Dead Eye core ranks again. Off by default; existing core ranks are preserved either way.
help.WalletCap|Rank10Dollars: Wallet capacity in dollars at Gambler challenge rank 10. 0 means unlimited.
help.CoreClock|HealthDrainHours: In-game hours needed to drain Arthur/John's Health core from 100 to 0. It keeps draining during sleep. Saved changes are re-read within about two real seconds and affect future in-game minutes; no restart is required.
help.CoreClock|StaminaDrainHours: In-game hours needed to drain Arthur/John's Stamina core from 100 to 0. It keeps draining during sleep. Saved changes are re-read within about two real seconds and affect future in-game minutes; no restart is required.
help.Pocketwatch|FontFace: Selects the built-in RDR2 font face used by the pocket-watch clock. Invalid or missing values fall back to Classic Serif. Saved changes hot-reload within about two seconds.
help.Pocketwatch|TextSize: Clock font size in 1920x1080 reference pixels. Valid values are 12-64. Saved changes are validated and re-read within about two real seconds; no restart is required.
help.Pocketwatch|PositionXPercent: Right-aligned clock edge as a percentage of screen width. 0 is the left edge and 100 is the right edge. Hot-reloads within about two seconds.
help.Pocketwatch|PositionYPercent: Clock top edge as a percentage of screen height. 0 is the top and 100 is the bottom. Hot-reloads within about two seconds.
help.Thermometer|PositionXPercent: Right-aligned temperature edge as a percentage of screen width. 0 is the left edge and 100 is the right edge. Hot-reloads within about one second.
help.Thermometer|PositionYPercent: Temperature top edge as a percentage of screen height. 0 is the top and 100 is the bottom. Hot-reloads within about one second.
help.CoreClock|DeadEyeDrainHours: In-game hours needed to drain Arthur/John's Dead Eye core from 100 to 0 while awake. Dead Eye refills during sleep instead. Saved changes are re-read within about two real seconds; no restart is required.
help.CoreClock|HorseHealthDrainHours: In-game hours needed to drain the owned or currently ridden horse's Health core from 100 to 0, including elapsed sleep time. This value is independent of Arthur/John's Health core. Saved changes are re-read within about two real seconds and affect future in-game minutes; no restart is required.
help.CoreClock|HorseStaminaDrainHours: In-game hours needed to drain the owned or currently ridden horse's Stamina core from 100 to 0, including elapsed sleep time. This value is independent of Arthur/John's Stamina core. Saved changes are re-read within about two real seconds and affect future in-game minutes; no restart is required.
help.DeadEye|ConsumptionPointsPerSecond: How many outer Dead Eye bar points are drained per real second while Dead Eye is active. The game treats 0 as its default drain, so the supported range starts at 1. Saved changes hot-reload within about two seconds.
help.CoreClock|WriteMode: Which native writes the core value. Core values must use _SET_ATTRIBUTE_CORE_VALUE; SET_ATTRIBUTE_POINTS is permanent progression XP and changes the player's maximum outer rings. Changing this can destroy saved core ranks.
help.Toxicity|Enabled: Oleander applies Toxic until a Health Cure is consumed.
help.Temperature|HeatDrainMultiplier: Multiplies BaseDrainHours while the game reports heat exposure. The exposure state already accounts for clothing.
help.Temperature|ColdDrainMultiplier: Multiplies BaseDrainHours while the game reports cold exposure. The exposure state already accounts for clothing.
help.NoReserveCores|DeadEyeEmptyPercent: How empty the normalized Dead Eye outer meter must be before Dead Eye is cut off and latched unavailable. Raise it if Dead Eye still fires when it looks empty; lower it if it cuts off too soon.
help.NoReserveCores|SprintCutBarPercent: Cut sprint while the outer Stamina bar still has this much left. Raise it if you can still see the bar dip into the core; lower it if sprint cuts out too early.
help.NoReserveCores|BarFloorPercent: At or below this outer-bar percentage, any drop in the matching core is refused outright. Raise it if a core still moves while its bar is empty.
help.WagonCores|DrainPerSecond: Real outer-Stamina points per real second for every horse harnessed to the wagon. The HUD shows the weakest member of the team.
help.WagonCores|MinimumSpeed: The team must be moving at least this fast before any drain is applied.
help.TrainTracking|Enabled: Shows active trains on the map from the engine's own train manager.
help.CollectibleMap|ClearRadius: Come within this many metres of a marker and it is treated as collected: the blip is removed and remembered in collectibles_collected.txt so it stays gone across sessions. Delete that file to reset all markers.
help.CollectibleMap|GangHideouts: Show gang hideouts on the world map.
help.CollectibleMap|DeveloperMoveMaxDistance: Development builds only. F2 moves the nearest marker to where you are standing, saved to collectibles_fixups.csv. F2 refuses the move when the nearest marker is farther away than this, so a stray keypress cannot move a distant marker.
help.CollectibleProbe|Enabled: Reverse-engineering probe for TODO #147. Set it on, load a save and press F10 to append read-only native-call results to GameplayTweaks.probe.log. Leave off for normal play.
help.SharedAmmoCaps|Caliber225: One combined carry limit for every .225 cartridge used by pistols and the varmint rifle, in any mix of variants. 0 leaves the pool on vanilla caps.
help.SharedAmmoCaps|Caliber307: One combined carry limit for every .307 revolver cartridge, in any mix of variants. 0 leaves the pool on vanilla caps.
help.SharedAmmoCaps|Caliber444: One combined carry limit for every .444 repeater, rifle and sniper cartridge, in any mix of variants. 0 leaves the pool on vanilla caps.
help.SharedAmmoCaps|Shotgun: One combined carry limit for all shotgun shell variants. 0 leaves the pool on vanilla caps.
help.SharedAmmoCaps|Arrow: One combined carry limit for all arrow variants. 0 leaves the pool on vanilla caps.
help.SharedItemCaps|Herbs: One combined carry limit across all 33 herb types listed in shared_item_caps.csv. 0 leaves herbs on vanilla per-item caps.
help.SharedItemCaps|Food: One combined carry limit across all 90 food and drink items listed in shared_item_caps.csv. 0 leaves them on vanilla per-item caps.
help.CombatRoll|StaminaCost: Outer-stamina points spent once when an authored directional combat roll starts. Set 0 for free rolls.
help.CombatRoll|InvulnerabilitySeconds: Seconds from the start of the roll during which Arthur or John cannot be damaged. This plus Recovery Duration is the total roll length. Hot-reloads for the next roll.
help.CombatRoll|RecoverySeconds: Vulnerable seconds after invulnerability ends. Invulnerability Duration plus this value is the total roll length. Hot-reloads for the next roll.
help.CombatRoll|InvulnerabilityOpacityPercent: Player opacity during the invulnerable prefix: 0 is invisible and 100 is fully opaque. The exact pre-roll opacity is restored at the boundary. Hot-reloads for the next roll.
help.Prone|HoldMs: How long the Duck input must be held to enter prone. A tap remains Rockstar's ordinary crouch toggle.
help.Prone|TurnDegreesPerSecond: How fast the prone body turns on the spot.
help.Prone|PitchSign: Flip between 1 and -1 if AlignToGround pitches him the wrong way on slopes.
help.Prone|RollSign: Flip between 1 and -1 if AlignToGround rolls him the wrong way on slopes.
help.Climbing|IdleStaminaPerSecond: Stamina drained per second while hanging on a surface without moving.
help.Climbing|MoveStaminaPerSecond: Stamina drained per second while climbing at normal speed.
help.Climbing|SprintStaminaPerSecond: Stamina drained per second while climbing at sprint speed.
help.Climbing|LeapStaminaCost: Stamina spent on one climbing leap.
help.Climbing|LeapDistanceMeters: How far a climbing leap can reach.
help.Climbing|GrabDistanceMeters: How close a surface must be before it can be grabbed.
help.Climbing|MinimumSurfaceAngleDegrees: Surfaces shallower than this are walked on rather than climbed.
help.Climbing|ProbeToleranceMeters: How much variation the multi-height surface probes tolerate before they treat it as a different face.
help.Climbing|SurfaceSmoothing: How heavily the fitted surface plane is smoothed between frames. Higher is steadier and slower to react.
help.Climbing|PitchSign: Flip between 1 and -1 if AlignPitchToSurface leans him head-first into the rock instead of along it.
help.BanditMasks|MetalWitnessTalkChance: Chance a witness still talks while the Metal mask is worn.
help.BanditMasks|PigFenceMoneyMultiplier: Fence payout multiplier while the Pig mask is worn.
help.BanditMasks|Rank4GlassesItem: Item id for the rank 4 Outlaw Pass glasses. Intentionally blank until that item is imported.
help.BanditMasks|SackBountyGainMultiplier: Bounty accrual multiplier while the Sack mask is worn.
help.BanditMasks|CatHorseRecoveryMultiplier: Horse recovery multiplier while the Cat mask is worn.
help.BanditMasks|PsychoMeleeDamageMultiplier: Melee damage dealt multiplier while the Psycho mask is worn.
help.BanditMasks|PsychoBulletDamageTakenMulti: Bullet damage taken multiplier while the Psycho mask is worn.
help.BanditMasks|PaganHonorLossMultiplier: Honor loss multiplier while the Pagan mask is worn.
help.BanditMasks|BanditMasterLawPerceptionMul: Law perception multiplier while the Bandit Master mask is worn.
help.HonorPrices|FenceReversed: At fences, including the wagon fence and horse fence, the honor curve is mirrored: rank -8 gets the Rank+8 multiplier and vice versa, so lower honor means better fence deals. The Executioner's Mask exemption does not apply while reversed.
help.Binoculars|HoldMs: Hold the cover input past this long to raise the binoculars. A shorter press is ordinary native cover.
help.Binoculars|RequireOwned: Require the binoculars to actually be in the satchel.
help.Binoculars|DrawMs: How long the satchel draw animation is given before the scope takes over. Raise it if the draw gets cut short.
help.Binoculars|StowMs: How long the put-away animation is given before your previous weapon comes back. Raise it if it gets cut short.
help.Binoculars|MaskScale: Size of the clear binocular opening; larger means less screen covered. Range 0.60-1.60.
help.Binoculars|ShowZoomReadout: Shows the real current rendered FOV and native zoom factor while looking, so zoom steps can be compared directly.
help.CompendiumGlintProbe|Enabled: Temporary read-only reverse-engineering probe. Enable only while collecting the ordered comparison captures documented on GitHub issue #85.
help.ReconTagging|StudyTimeMs: How long a living ped must be held near screen centre through binoculars, or while aiming, before it is tagged.
help.ReconTagging|MinProjectedExtent: Minimum on-screen size of the target, measured as the square root of its projected bounding-box area from all eight model corners. It responds continuously to size, angle, distance, FOV and zoom without size buckets.
help.ReconTagging|MaxDistanceMeters: Targets farther away than this cannot be tagged.
help.ReconTagging|TagFadeStartMeters: Completed human, animal, horse, and plant tags stay fully opaque through this distance in metres. They then fade linearly until Tag Fadeout End. This is independent of tagging distance and hot-reloads within about two real seconds.
help.ReconTagging|TagFadeEndMeters: Completed tags are fully transparent and are not drawn at or beyond this distance in metres. The fade is linear from Tag Fadeout Start to this endpoint. If the end is not above the start, the runtime places it one metre above the start. Hot-reloads within about two real seconds.
help.ReconTagging|WeaponAimMaxDistanceMeters: Maximum acquisition distance for ordinary weapon aim. Active rifle scopes and binoculars use Maximum Acquisition Distance instead. Saved changes hot-reload within about two real seconds.
help.ReconTagging|EnablePlantTagging: Allows plant acquisition and completed plant tags. Turning this off clears existing plant tags without affecting human or animal tags. Saved changes hot-reload within about two real seconds.
help.ReconTagging|ScreenCenterTolerancePercen: How far from exact screen center a marker anchor may sit and still be studied, as a percentage of normalized screen coordinates. For example, 5% is an internal radius of 0.05. The supported range is 0.1-35%, and saved changes hot-reload within about two real seconds.
help.ReconTagging|TagDisplayMode: 2D keeps tag art at a fixed screen size. 3D scales the complete HUD tag and distance text between the configured maximum and minimum size multipliers. Both modes remain non-occluded HUD art and hot-reload within about two real seconds.
help.ReconTagging|TagHeadGapMeters: World-space height in metres from the target anchor to the bottom of the tag. The same perspective-aware gap is used in 2D and 3D modes and hot-reloads within about two real seconds.
help.ReconTagging|Tag3DMinSizeMultiplier: 3D mode reaches this multiplier exactly at Tag Fadeout End. The tag, distance text, and text gap use the same value. If it is above the maximum setting, the runtime raises the effective maximum to match it. Hot-reloads within about two real seconds.
help.ReconTagging|Tag3DMaxSizeMultiplier: 3D mode starts from this multiplier at zero distance and interpolates linearly toward the minimum at Tag Fadeout End. The tag, distance text, and text gap use the same value. Hot-reloads within about two real seconds.
help.ReconTagging|MaxTags: Maximum number of live recon tags at once.
help.ReconTagging|MinimapBlips: Also show recon tags on the minimap.
help.ReconTagging|CoreTrack: Draws the grey fillable-capacity ring behind a recon tag's white health arc, so damage reads as white shrinking into grey. The white live health arc itself is always drawn.
help.BottleProbe|Enabled: Investigation only; changes nothing in game. Logs which drinking animation clip is playing and what bottle prop exists to GameplayTweaks.bottle.log. It polls every frame, so turn it off when done.
help.EmptyBottles|HumanTonicBottles: Controls Health Cures, Bitters, Snake Oils and Miracle Tonics together. Whiskey, brandy, gin and rum always yield a bottle regardless.
help.CarriedMask|Item: Internal item id updated automatically from the full-face mask selected through Rockstar's wardrobe.
help.Temperature|BaseDrainHours: Additional hot/cold exposure drain only. At multiplier 1, continuous exposure empties the affected core in this many in-game hours; Core Clock separately controls ordinary time-based drain.
help.LostMoney|MapIconScale: Size of the bloodstain marker's map blip.
help.LostMoney|WorldMarkerScale: Size of the bloodstain marker drawn in the world.
help.RadialAmmoScroll|CentreDeadzone: How near the radial's centre the pointer must be before the wheel cycles ammunition. Over a weapon slot, Rockstar's behavior wins.
help.RadialAmmoScroll|RequireOwnedAmmo: Only cycle to ammunition types you actually carry.
help.RadialAmmoScroll|Wrap: Wrap around from the last ammunition type back to the first.
help.RadialAmmoScroll|ShowFeedText: Show an on-screen feed line naming the ammunition you scrolled to.
help.RadialAmmoCounts|LiveR: Red channel, 0-255, of the count text for a nonzero reserve.
help.RadialAmmoCounts|LiveG: Green channel, 0-255, of the count text for a nonzero reserve.
help.RadialAmmoCounts|LiveB: Blue channel, 0-255, of the count text for a nonzero reserve.
help.RadialAmmoCounts|LiveA: Alpha, 0-255, of the count text for a nonzero reserve.
help.RadialAmmoCounts|ZeroR: Red channel, 0-255, of the count text for an empty reserve.
help.RadialAmmoCounts|ZeroG: Green channel, 0-255, of the count text for an empty reserve.
help.RadialAmmoCounts|ZeroB: Blue channel, 0-255, of the count text for an empty reserve.
help.RadialAmmoCounts|ZeroA: Alpha, 0-255, of the count text for an empty reserve.
help.RadialAmmoCounts|CountBaselineY: Ten-thousandths of screen height: where the digits sit.
help.RadialAmmoCounts|NudgeY: Signed whole-overlay vertical offset, in ten-thousandths of screen height.
help.RadialAmmoCounts|HeartbeatMs: Idle heartbeat period for GameplayTweaks.radial-ammo-counts.log, so a silent log proves the module is not running rather than that nothing happened.
help.ProjectileSpeed|GlobalFirearmSpeed: Vanilla ordinary firearms use 2000. This is a data-build setting, not a live native: after changing it run ApplyProjectileSpeed.ps1 and restart the game. Arrows, thrown weapons, explosives, lasso and animal attacks are excluded.
help.ProjectileVisibility|TailSegments: How many tapering segments make up the luminous streak's tail.
help.SpentCasings|LifetimeSeconds: How long a dropped casing stays in the world before it is removed.
help.SpentCasings|MaximumWorldCasings: Hard ceiling on simultaneously spawned casings.
help.SpentCasings|PickupSoundSet: Sound bank half of the collect sound. The game addresses sounds as set plus name.
help.SpentCasings|GlowRange: Radius in metres of the optional per-casing point light.
help.SpentCasings|GlintBrightness: RGB brightness multiplier, 0-1, of the game's soft particle glint on each casing.
help.SpentCasings|GlintFadeInMs: Fade-in part of the glint's alpha envelope. Fade values may overlap; the lower side wins, producing one soft peak.
help.SpentCasings|GlintFadeOutMs: Fade-out part of the glint's alpha envelope. Fade values may overlap; the lower side wins, producing one soft peak.
help.SpentCasings|GlintTimingRandomnessMs: Randomizes GlintPauseMs by plus or minus this much, and gives each new casing a random initial delay from 0 to this value, so a revolver reload does not flash all six chambers in lockstep.
help.DuplicateCigaretteCards|Enabled: Protects cards needed for an unmailed set. After a complete set has been mailed, later copies are converted to the sellable duplicate record.
help.PremiumCigaretteCards|ChancePercent: Percent chance rolled when the authored smoking animation actually consumes one Premium Cigarette. Obtaining, buying, collecting or discarding Premium Cigarettes does not roll. Until all 144 cards are owned, a successful roll selects a card not currently owned; after that, duplicates are allowed. Saved changes are re-read within about two real seconds; no restart is required.
help.CoreCostGuard|Enabled: Greys out a consumable when any of its negative core effects would take Health, Stamina, or Dead Eye below 0. An item whose cost exactly equals the remaining core is allowed. Saved changes are re-read within about two real seconds; no restart is required.
help.BeltLantern|LightsAtHour: In-game clock hour the belt lantern lights itself after dark.
help.BeltLantern|OutAtHour: In-game clock hour the belt lantern goes out.
help.BeltLantern|Range: Belt lantern light radius in metres.
help.BeltLantern|AttachmentPoint: Selects the rigid player-equipment bone used by the physical lantern joint. The default is the character attachment point used by this mod, not a built-in belt-lantern command. Other choices can overlap weapons or clothing. Changes rebuild the lantern without a restart.
help.Camera|BlendSpeed: How quickly the camera blends during shoulder swaps and stance/profile changes. Lower is smoother/slower; higher is snappier. Re-read live and clamped to 0.01-10.00.
help.Camera|LockToOneThirdPersonZoom: Removes the two intermediate third-person zoom steps on foot, so the view key only picks between this framing and first person.
help.Camera|LockToOneThirdPersonZoomMounted: The same two-mode lock on horseback and in vehicles. First person remains available; the three third-person steps collapse to one.
help.Camera|AimHorizontalOverride: #175 diagnostic, not a fix. On (default) keeps the shipped behaviour where this mod asserts the aim shoulder offset. Off hands the sideways offset back to the game so a genuine shoulder mirror can be observed in the log. Turn it off, aim, and press the shoulder-swap key a few times each way; hot-reloads.
help.Camera|AimShoulderOffset: Horizontal camera offset while aiming from a standing posture.
help.Camera|AimDistance: Camera orbit distance while aiming from a standing posture.
help.Camera|AimLowCamera: Uses Rockstar's binary LOW framing while aiming from a standing posture. This is a real framing switch, not a continuous vertical coordinate.
help.Camera|CrouchedAimShoulderOffset: Independent horizontal camera offset while crouched and aiming.
help.Camera|CrouchedAimDistance: Independent camera orbit distance while crouched and aiming.
help.Camera|CrouchedAimLowCamera: Uses Rockstar's binary LOW framing while crouched and aiming. Enabled by default so crouch-aim stays lower instead of being reset by the standing Aim profile.
help.Camera|DisableHorseCameraCentering: Disables mounted follow-camera centering through the project-owned cameras.ymt package. A change prepares the LML package for the next game start; restart RDR2 to apply it.
help.WantedSystem|TraceEnabled: Observes active-search and post-search law states without changing wanted state.
help.WantedSystem|TraceIntervalMs: How often the wanted-system trace samples law state.
help.WantedSystem|TraceTailSeconds: How much trailing history the wanted-system trace keeps.
help.WantedSystem|VisualMarkerKey: Virtual-key code that marks the visible dark-red law-dot phase begin and end in the trace. 119 is F8.
help.Fortification|ShowBars: Repaint the spent part of each fortified outer bar ring.
help.Fortification|ShowCores: Repaint the spent part of each fortified inner core ring.
help.Fortification|BoxWidth: Meter box width in ten-thousandths of the screen, using the same integer encoding as HardcoreStamina.ini.
help.Fortification|BoxHeight: Meter box height in ten-thousandths of the screen, using the same integer encoding as HardcoreStamina.ini.
help.Fortification|BarRingScale: Outer bar ring size as a percentage of the meter box.
help.Fortification|CoreRingScale: Inner core ring size as a percentage of the meter box.
help.Fortification|NudgeX: Horizontal offset applied to all five meters at once, in ten-thousandths of screen width.
help.Fortification|NudgeY: Vertical offset applied to all five meters at once, in ten-thousandths of screen height.
